answers.q1: Yarn 1 classic monorepo (yarn workspaces; the root package.json pins "packageManager": "yarn@1.22.22", Node 20.x in CI). Install from the repository root with: yarn install
answers.q2: yarn test:app --watch=false (the root "test" script is plain vitest, which stays in watch mode locally; --watch=false runs it once, as CI does). The broader yarn test:all also runs typecheck, lint and prettier.
answers.q4: yarn test:other && yarn test:code && yarn test:typecheck (test:other = prettier --list-different, test:code = eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx ., test:typecheck = tsc; these are the three commands run in .github/workflows/lint.yml after yarn install)
answers.q5: Generated, do not hand-edit: packages/excalidraw/types (gitignored, emitted by the build), build/ and dist/ output dirs (excalidraw-app/build, excalidraw-app/dist, packages/*/dist, packages/*/build), excalidraw-app/dev-dist, public/workbox (PWA output), coverage/. Vendored: the hashed font binaries under packages/excalidraw/fonts/ (e.g. Excalifont/*.woff2). Translation files packages/excalidraw/locales/*.json other than en.json are synced from Crowdin (crowdin.yml), so edit en.json and let Crowdin manage the rest. Note: this directory is not a git repository, so I could only confirm these from the ignore files, workflows and config, not from git status.
